name: Nintendo Switch (original, HAC-001)
notes: Size is with Joy-Con attached; Nintendo does not publish a console-only size. max_depth_mm is from analog stick tip to ZL/ZR button surface. Weight_g is console only.

name: Nintendo Switch - OLED Model (HEG-001)
notes: Size is with Joy-Con attached; no console-only size published. max_depth_mm is from analog stick tip to ZL/ZR button surface.

name: Nintendo Switch Lite (HDH-001)
notes: Integrated controls. max_depth_mm is from analog stick tip to ZL/ZR button surface.

name: Nintendo Switch 2
notes: Size is with Joy-Con 2 attached (no console-only size published). max_depth_mm is from control stick tips to ZL/ZR. EU user-replaceable-battery version weighs approx. 441 g (548 g with Joy-Con 2).

name: Nintendo Joy-Con (original, single controller)
notes: Same size for L and R; depth 28.4 mm is max thickness including stick and ZL/ZR. Size without wrist strap.

name: Nintendo Joy-Con 2 (single controller)
notes: Same size for L and R; depth 30.7 mm is max thickness from stick tip to ZL/ZR. Nintendo UK page lists width as 14.4 mm (apparent typo for 41.4). EU user-replaceable-battery versions weigh 68 g (L) / 69 g (R).

name: Sony PS5 DualSense Wireless Controller
notes: PlayStation store lists approx. H66 x W160 x D106 mm and approx. 0.3 kg; Thai/Latvian retailers list approx. 280 g and note dimensions exclude the largest projection. height_mm is thickness lying flat, depth_mm is front-to-back (grips).

name: Microsoft Xbox Wireless Controller (Series X|S model)
notes: Microsoft does not publish dimensions on xbox.com. Figures from retailer/review listings (Clubic 153 x 102 x 61 mm, 287 g; PC Richard 6.02 x 4.01 x 2.40 in); height_mm is thickness lying flat, depth_mm front-to-back. Weight likely without AA batteries; other retailers list 380+ g (probably with batteries/packaging).

name: Apple AirPods (3rd generation) charging case
notes: Same size for Lightning and MagSafe charging case. Apple: size and weight vary by configuration and manufacturing process.

name: Apple AirPods 4 charging case (USB-C)
notes: AirPods 4 with ANC case (with speaker, wireless charging) has identical size, weight 34.7 g. Note: some apple.com regional spec pages now show 'AirPods 5' with the same case dimensions.

name: Apple AirPods Pro 2 MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C)
notes: Case with speaker and lanyard loop. Apple: size and weight vary by configuration and manufacturing process.

name: Apple AirPods Pro 3 MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C)
notes: Released 2025. Apple: size and weight vary by configuration and manufacturing process.

name: USB Type-C plug (USB-IF critical dimensions)
notes: Plug width/thickness tol +/-0.03, plug length (exposed metal from overmold face) +/-0.10; receptacle opening width +0.06/-0.02, height +/-0.04 (USB-IF Compliance Doc rev 1.2, Figs B-1/B-5). A GitHub thread claims a later USB-IF ECN enlarged the overmold envelope to 12.85 x 7.0 mm; unverified.

name: Apple USB-C charge cable (240W woven 2 m, A2794)
notes: Plug boot width/thickness/length NOT found in any reputable measured source; overmold_max values are the USB-IF upper bound, not Apple measurements. Cable diameter and weight measured by ChargerLAB; an Apple Community user reports ~3.0 mm for the 1 m non-woven cable.
